SELECT bpr.billId, DATE_FORMAT(bpr.orderDate, '%Y-%m-%d') orderDate, bpr.billNum, bpr.orgId, bpr.orgName, bpr.patientId, bpr.patientName, bpr.mobile, bpr.regDentistId, bpr.regDentistName, IFNULL(bpr.originalAmount,0) originalAmount, IFNULL(bpr.discountAmount,0) discountAmount, IFNULL(bpr.actualAmount,0) actualAmount, bpr.privilegeType, bpr.payeeId, bpr.payeeName FROM ( SELECT bb.bill_id AS billId, bb.order_date AS orderDate, bb.bill_num AS billNum, bb.org_id AS orgId, bo.abbreviation AS orgName, bb.patient_id AS patientId, bp.`name` AS patientName, bp.pinyin_name AS pinyinName, bp.mobile AS mobile, btp.registered_dentist_id AS regDentistId, btp.employee_name AS regDentistName, bb.order_amount AS originalAmount, bb.privilege_amount AS discountAmount, bb.actual_amount AS actualAmount, bb.privilege_type AS privilegeType, bbp.payee_user_id AS payeeId, bbp.employee_name AS payeeName FROM base_bill bb LEFT JOIN base_organization bo ON bb.org_id = bo.org_id LEFT JOIN base_patient bp ON bb.patient_id = bp.patient_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT btp.registered_dentist_id, btp.treatment_id, be.employee_name FROM base_treatment_process btp LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON btp.registered_dentist_id = be.user_id ) btp ON bb.treatment_id = btp.treatment_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT bb.order_id as bill_id,bb.operate_user_id as payee_user_id,be.employee_name FROM (select order_id,operate_user_id from base_benefit group by order_id,operate_user_id) bb LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON bb.operate_user_id = be.user_id ) bbp ON bb.bill_id = bbp.bill_id ) bpr
and concat(IFNULL(bpr.patientName, ''), IFNULL(bpr.pinyinName, ''), IFNULL(bpr.mobile, '')) like concat('%', #{query.keyWord}, '%')
and bpr.billNum like concat('%', #{query.billNum} ,'%')
and bpr.orgId in
#{item}
and DATE_FORMAT(bpr.orderDate,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.orderStartDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(bpr.orderDate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.orderEndDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and bpr.regDentistId in
#{item}
and bpr.privilegeType in
#{item}
order by bpr.orderDate desc

SELECT (select count(DISTINCT patient_id ) from base_bill where org_id = #{orgId} AND debt_amount > 0) numberPatient, count(*) arrearsCount, sum(debt_amount) debtAmount FROM base_bill WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND debt_amount > 0

SELECT bbp.patient_id, bbp.patientName, bbp.gender, bbp.mobile, bbp.totalActualAmount, bbp.totalReceivedAmount, bbp.totalRemainingArrearsAmount FROM ( SELECT bb.patient_id, bp.`name` AS patientName, bp.pinyin_name AS pinyinName, bp.gender, bp.mobile, bb.totalActualAmount, bb.totalReceivedAmount, bb.totalRemainingArrearsAmount FROM ( SELECT bb.patient_id, IFNULL( SUM( bb.actual_amount ), 0 ) AS totalActualAmount, IFNULL( SUM( bb.received_amount ), 0 ) AS totalReceivedAmount, IFNULL( SUM( bb.debt_amount ), 0 ) AS totalRemainingArrearsAmount FROM base_bill bb WHERE bb.debt_amount > 0 GROUP BY bb.patient_id ) bb LEFT JOIN base_patient bp ON bb.patient_id = bp.patient_id ) bbp
and concat(IFNULL(bbp.patientName, ''), IFNULL(bbp.pinyinName, ''), IFNULL(bbp.mobile, '')) like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')

SELECT bb.orgId, bo.abbreviation AS orgName, btp.regDentistId, btp.regDentistName, bb.billId, bb.billNum, DATE_FORMAT(bb.billDate, '%Y-%m-%d') as billDate, bb.originalAmount, bb.privilegeAmount, bb.actualAmount, bb.receivedAmount, bb.remainingArrears FROM ( SELECT bb.org_id AS orgId, bb.bill_id AS billId, bb.bill_date AS billDate, bb.bill_num AS billNum, bb.treatment_id, bb.order_amount AS originalAmount, bb.actual_amount AS actualAmount, bb.received_amount AS receivedAmount, bb.debt_amount AS remainingArrears, bb.privilege_amount AS privilegeAmount FROM base_bill bb WHERE bb.debt_amount > 0 and bb.patient_id = #{patientId} ) bb LEFT JOIN base_organization bo ON bb.orgId = bo.org_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT btp.treatment_id, btp.registered_dentist_id AS regDentistId, be.employee_name AS regDentistName FROM base_treatment_process btp LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON btp.registered_dentist_id = be.user_id WHERE btp.treat_status = 4 GROUP BY btp.treatment_id ) btp ON bb.treatment_id = btp.treatment_id GROUP BY bb.billId ORDER BY bb.billDate DESC

SELECT bbp.dentistId, bbp.dentistName, COUNT( bbp.bill_id ) AS outstandingBillCount, SUM( bbp.debt_amount ) AS totalArrearsAmount FROM ( SELECT btp.dentistId, btp.dentistName, bb.bill_id, bb.debt_amount FROM ( SELECT bb.bill_id, bb.treatment_id, bb.debt_amount FROM base_bill bb WHERE bb.debt_amount > 0 ) bb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT btp.treatment_id, btp.registered_dentist_id AS dentistId, be.employee_name AS dentistName FROM base_treatment_process btp LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON btp.registered_dentist_id = be.user_id WHERE btp.treat_status = 4 GROUP BY btp.treatment_id ) btp ON bb.treatment_id = btp.treatment_id ) bbp
and bbp.dentistId in
#{item}
GROUP BY bbp.dentistId ORDER BY totalArrearsAmount DESC
SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT patient_id ) AS arrearsPatientCount, COUNT( bill_id ) AS arrearsBillCount, SUM( debt_amount ) AS totalArrears FROM base_bill WHERE debt_amount > 0

SELECT any_value(a.item_id) as itemId, any_value(a.bill_id) as billId, any_value(a.item_name) as itemName, any_value(a.unit) as unit, any_value(a.price) as price, any_value(a.quantity) as quantity, (any_value(a.price) * any_value(a.quantity)) as originPrice, IF(any_value(bb.coupon_type)=99,any_value(bpm.member_level_name),any_value(bcpon.coupon_name)) as couponName, IF(any_value(bb.coupon_type)=99,'',any_value(bc.card_number)) as cardNumber, any_value(bc.sale_channel_name) as saleChannelName, any_value(bc.card_number) as cardNumber, any_value(bo.abbreviation) as abbreviation, any_value(bc.sale_channel_name) as saleChannelName, any_value(bcpon.coupon_name) as couponName, IFNULL((any_value(bb.benefit_amount) * any_value(a.quantity)),0) as benefitAmount, IFNULL(be2.employee_name,'---') as operateUserName, any_value(be.employee_name) as employeeName FROM ( SELECT bbd.org_id, bbd.bill_id, bbd.executor_id, bbd.item_id, bbd.item_type, (select count(*) from base_benefit where order_id=bbd.bill_id) quantity, bbd.price, bti.unit, bti.item_name, bti.category_name FROM base_bill_detail bbd LEFT JOIN base_tariff_info bti ON bti.item_id = bbd.item_id AND bti.item_type = bbd.item_type WHERE bbd.bill_id = #{billId} ) a LEFT JOIN base_benefit bb on (bb.order_id=a.bill_id and bb.item_id = a.item_id and a.item_type = bb.item_type) LEFT JOIN base_card bc on bc.card_id = bb.card_id LEFT JOIN base_coupon bcpon on bcpon.coupon_id = bc.coupon_id LEFT JOIN base_employee be on be.user_id = a.executor_id LEFT JOIN base_patient_member bpm on bpm.member_level_id=bb.card_id LEFT JOIN base_organization bo on bo.org_id = a.org_id LEFT JOIN base_employee be2 on be2.user_id = bb.operate_user_id group by a.item_id, a.bill_id, a.item_name, a.unit, a.price, a.quantity, bb.coupon_type, bpm.member_level_name, bcpon.coupon_name, bc.card_number, bc.sale_channel_name, bc.card_number, bo.abbreviation, bc.sale_channel_name, bcpon.coupon_name, bb.benefit_amount, be.employee_name, be2.employee_name
select sum(bb.actual_amount) as cumulativeConsumption, sum(bb.debt_amount) as totalArrears from base_bill bb where bb.patient_id = #{patientId}
